scope: Each paired capture uses the same conservative common host-time intersection for P and D. Two-anchor clock mapping accounts for measured offset drift. Anchor uncertainty remains recorded. Kernel busy is the union of observed kernel intervals. Copy unions are separate and can overlap kernels. Three profiles come from three independent Clean/Profile/Clean triplets whose full/exposed metric CIs pass5percent. This does not establish all-engine physical idle,a future executable window,or sustainable capacity. The common READ/compute policy is not the original motivation runtime.
